reason: Keep: one very slender white paper/fine-fabric humanoid with a blank faceless head, two ribbon-thin arms and two legs. Keep the feet planted in or beside the paddy, the rice and water dead still, and humanlike scale (kunekune-urban-legend-c01/c03/c04/c11/c12/c13). Fix: (a) Make the wriggle read as wrong and alive, not graceful. Use a rail-thin, sexless, straight-hipped body, not an hourglass mannequin, with no contrapposto and no knee-forward model pose. The torso and both arms twist in many tight, uneven ripples along their whole length, like cloth whipped in a gale, and the head is jerked to a broken angle. Every rice blade and the water stay motionless around it. (b) Light: a bleached white-hot noon sky, heat haze visibly warping the far paddies, a harsh overhead sun, and a short hard black shadow at the feet. No pale-blue sky with wispy clouds. (c) Composition: a lower, closer, off-centre camera, so the figure looms over the viewer across the still water instead of standing centred on the path like a statue. No face, eyes, mouth, aura, curse or madness effects (c08), and no text.
prompt: ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Kunekune, the slender white paperlike humanoid wriggling in a windless rice paddy. ANATOMY: ONE extremely thin opaque white fine-fabric humanoid, ONE smooth blank elongated head with absolutely NO face, TWO long ribbon-thin arms and TWO narrow legs, no fingers, no extra limbs. The limbs and torso are white paper/fabric throughout, not a person wearing a white costume [kunekune-urban-legend-c01,c04]. MOMENT: WRITHE IN PLACE while BOTH FEET remain PLANTED side by side on the dike edge. Torso twists into a severe S curve; BOTH arms hang to either side of body in distinct long rippling S-shaped waves, as fabric driven by a strong straight gust, even though the surrounding air is utterly still. Hands stay below shoulder level, head inclines impossibly sideways above the twisted torso. A disturbing arrested convulsion, absolutely NO running stride, raised knee, jump, leap, dance, ballet, jaunty pose, or outstretched celebratory arms [c03,c12,c13]. POWER: permanent windless wriggle only; surrounding rice stalks stand perfectly straight and motionless and paddy water is mirror still. No magic beam or mind/curse effects. SCALE & CAMERA: very low close camera along empty dike; whole white figure almost fills square top to bottom, feet visible at bottom, thin distorted arms readable as two continuous limbs; humanlike scale, not a giant. LIGHT & WEATHER: harsh HIGH WHITE MIDDAY SUMMER SUN, near-white sky, scorching heat shimmer beyond figure, hard deep black-green shadows; sun outside frame, no sunset, no moon, no golden-hour glow, no rain or dust wind. SURFACE: matte white paper creases and gauze-fine folds under brutal noon light. SETTING: wide empty rice fields on a hot summer day; no village, houses, flowers, decorative sky or postcard backdrop [c01,c11]. MOOD: oppressive uncanny encounter, severe dangerous wrongness, never whimsical paper sculpture, cute or calm. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no face, eyes, nose, mouth or teeth; no extra heads, limbs, joints or fingers; no film/game/anime/comic designs; no nudity or gore; no aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. Square painterly illustration, crisp silhouette readable at 200 pixels.
